verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a plain C/C++ runtime with no dependencies, ships as pre-built binaries, and is praised for avoiding heavyweight Python stacks. Community discussion of the mmap change calls the faster loading time 'a huge win for usability', which addresses the cold-start concern directly. missing for 10: quantified cold-start or time-to-first-token measurements, first-party documentation of model load speed and mmap behavior.
